name: joy2know-mureka-maestro
description: joy2know Mureka Music Maestro: turns a song idea into a ready-to-paste two-column prompt pack for Mureka's Custom mode — a style column in either the official Chinese narrative six-block form (default, per Mureka's own templates) or the English-token seven-element form (genre, BPM, vocals, instruments, mood, scene, mixing), plus a Chinese lyrics column with section tags, a language declaration and explicit repeats, followed by the panel settings to tick before pasting. Specialises in jazz, blues and folk song prompts and their fusions, and plans whole albums (album brief intake, tone tokens, track table, difference matrix, time-signature and mode rationale, per-track prompts and cover prompts). Text only — no audio is generated, no generative AI API is called, no account or key is carried.

displayDescription.en: Turns a song idea into a ready-to-paste two-column prompt pack for Mureka, and plans whole albums. Text only.
displayDescription.zh: 把想法写成可粘贴进 Mureka 的双栏提示词包，也规划整张专辑：曲目表、差异矩阵、逐首提示词。仅产出文本。
